relationships.subject: cryptotanshinone
relationships.evidence_quote: In vitro findings demonstrated that Cry mitigates lactate-induced oxidative stress through modulation of the STAT3/SIRT3 signaling pathway, thereby reducing senescence, apoptosis, and extracellular matrix (ECM) degradation in NPCs.

relationships.subject: cryptotanshinone
relationships.evidence_quote: Meanwhile, the outcomes of molecular docking and Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis revealed that Cry exhibits a remarkable affinity towards STAT3.

key_findings: Cryptotanshinone binds STAT3 and mitigates lactate-induced oxidative stress, senescence, apoptosis and ECM degradation in nucleus pulposus cells.
Cryptotanshinone ameliorated IVDD progression in a needle-puncture rat model.
